design_decisions: Write-set model grounded in the actual writers: every per-row output basename is <stem> or <stem>_<suffix> (Engines/Base.py write_gdf_outputs call sites), under resolve_output_folder(settings). Two rows collide exactly when one stem is a PREFIX of the other within the same canonical output folder — the reviewer's ~4k-stem brute force found no non-prefix pair whose files collide, so the rule is complete for the actual writers, and conservative beyond them.

Read set covers all five per-row file inputs: network_file, origins_file, destinations_file, obstacle_points_file, observer_points_file (data_folder-relative, symlink-resolved, case-insensitive comparison).

output_wStamp=True (the Settings default) adds a timestamped subfolder; timestamps are clock-derived and not predictable at plan time. File-level independence still holds (basenames derive from the stem, not the clock), so rows are NOT serialized for wStamp alone; the plan carries an explicit note that the runtime resolves timestamps under its clock discipline (dossier: 'Timestamp values are compared under a controlled clock').
Case policy: canonical paths compared case-insensitively — the conservative direction; over-serialization can never corrupt, per dossier 'a different spelling is not independent'.
Aliasing detected by object identity BEFORE snapshotting; the same Settings object twice is an 'aliased_settings' hazard.
Non-base-type rows are per-row serial WITH a reason; proven-independent rows in the same batch are still admitted to workers — a batch is never rejected wholesale (dossier step 4).

The observable-prefix invariant is executable: verify_prefix raises InvariantViolation at the earliest differing prefix; ROW_TRANSITIONS / BATCH_TRANSITIONS name the ordered transitions the coordinator reproduces at commit time (steps 5-7 land with BATCH_EXEC against this spec).
handoffs: BATCH_EXEC (owns src/urban_network_analysis/batch/** + UNA.py): wire plan_batch into RunBatch(parallel=True) — admit_execution stays call-level; use plan.worker_admissible for the worker pool, plan.serialized reasons for batch_report, commit in plan.commit_order (truncated at the earliest error row), fold composite capture in plan.fold_order, call verify_prefix after every commit (bounded reorder buffer per dossier step 6), rehydrate final state without rerunning (step 7). Apply bind_settings and resolve_output_folder for SKIPPED rows too (they mutate observable state before the gate — NOTE-2). Carried UNA/Topology state is owned by the fresh-instance-per-worker rule (NOTE-4). The dossier's two runtime mutants (publish out of order / fold by completion) must fail against the runtime; the plan-level equivalents are already selected here.
BATCH_REVIEW: verify_prefix + ROW_TRANSITIONS are the review anchors for runtime serial/parallel equivalence claims.
INTEGRATE: plan.notes feeds batch_report notes verbatim (wStamp clock discipline, serial-route reasons, composite finalize ordering).
